Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when
                no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, assigned when the owner is
                created and formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code
                derived from the owner's postcode, the two-digit fiscal year
                derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July), the first eight upper-case
                hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name, and
                a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D45'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>': the literal 'FY' and the
                last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July, so a registration date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year of the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household,
                derived deterministically from the owner's last name and
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode are
                assigned the same value, so they form one household.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c442-98fc-3c14-9afb-4c8996fb9242'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this one softly matches on last name
                and postcode (with a different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned when the owner is
                created. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add
                1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 when
                the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when
                the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year, where tenure is the
                number of elapsed fiscal years (the current fiscal year minus the
                registration fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                'membershipPoints': level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived from the owner's locality/region using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registration date) at the time this owner was created; otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId
                (an absent email or householdId contributes an empty segment). A
                create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole identity
                key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birthDate is known.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining
                the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path for this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id. Absent until the owner has an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of
                these holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's e-mail domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it shares the registrable second-level name
                of a known disposable provider, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or
                'mail.mailinator.com', or is one of those domains), or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is
                true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'). When present it is used to compose the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. When structured fields are supplied they take precedence and
            the returned 'address' is composed from them. Optional at the schema
            level: an owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat 'address') plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When present
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address', is normalized the
            same way, and forms the composed 'address' returned in the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped,
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 40
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The e-mail address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address. The value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be a
            4-digit value valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when
                no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, assigned when the owner is
                created and formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code
                derived from the owner's postcode, the two-digit fiscal year
                derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July), the first eight upper-case
                hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name, and
                a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D45'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>': the literal 'FY' and the
                last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July, so a registration date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year of the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household,
                derived deterministically from the owner's last name and
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode are
                assigned the same value, so they form one household.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c442-98fc-3c14-9afb-4c8996fb9242'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this one softly matches on last name
                and postcode (with a different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned when the owner is
                created. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add
                1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 when
                the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when
                the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year, where tenure is the
                number of elapsed fiscal years (the current fiscal year minus the
                registration fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                'membershipPoints': level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived from the owner's locality/region using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registration date) at the time this owner was created; otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId
                (an absent email or householdId contributes an empty segment). A
                create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole identity
                key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birthDate is known.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining
                the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path for this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id. Absent until the owner has an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of
                these holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's e-mail domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it shares the registrable second-level name
                of a known disposable provider, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or
                'mail.mailinator.com', or is one of those domains), or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is
                true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'). When present it is used to compose the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. When structured fields are supplied they take precedence and
            the returned 'address' is composed from them. Optional at the schema
            level: an owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat 'address') plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When present
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address', is normalized the
            same way, and forms the composed 'address' returned in the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped,
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 40
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The e-mail address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address. The value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be a
            4-digit value valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when
                no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner-identity contract used to build this
                response. Always 2: the identifiers grouped under 'identity' are
                derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity: the memberId, identityKey and
                householdId, each rederived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes
                in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value produced under version 1
                is produced again.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>': the literal 'FY' and the
                last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July, so a registration date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year of the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household,
                derived deterministically from the owner's last name and
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode are
                assigned the same value, so they form one household.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c442-98fc-3c14-9afb-4c8996fb9242'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this one softly matches on last name
                and postcode (with a different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned when the owner is
                created. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add
                1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 when
                the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when
                the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year, where tenure is the
                number of elapsed fiscal years (the current fiscal year minus the
                registration fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                'membershipPoints': level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived from the owner's locality/region using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registration date) at the time this owner was created; otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId
                (an absent email or householdId contributes an empty segment). A
                create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole identity
                key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birthDate is known.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining
                the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path for this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id. Absent until the owner has an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of
                these holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's e-mail domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it shares the registrable second-level name
                of a known disposable provider, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or
                'mail.mailinator.com', or is one of those domains), or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is
                true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'). When present it is used to compose the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. When structured fields are supplied they take precedence and
            the returned 'address' is composed from them. Optional at the schema
            level: an owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat 'address') plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When present
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address', is normalized the
            same way, and forms the composed 'address' returned in the response.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped,
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 40
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The e-mail address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address. The value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be a
            4-digit value valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when
                no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner-identity contract used to build this
                response. Always 2: the identifiers grouped under 'identity' are
                derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity: the memberId, identityKey and
                householdId, each rederived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes
                in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value produced under version 1
                is produced again.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>': the literal 'FY' and the
                last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July, so a registration date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year of the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode with a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this one softly matches on last name
                and postcode (with a different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned when the owner is
                created. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add
                1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 when
                the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when
                the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year, where tenure is the
                number of elapsed fiscal years (the current fiscal year minus the
                registration fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                'membershipPoints': level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived from the owner's locality/region using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registration date) at the time this owner was created; otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId
                (an absent email or householdId contributes an empty segment). A
                create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when the whole identity
                key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                owner's registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when
                18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birthDate is known.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining
                the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path for this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id. Absent until the owner has an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of
                these holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's e-mail domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it shares the registrable second-level name
                of a known disposable provider, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or
                'mail.mailinator.com', or is one of those domains), or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is
                true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

        size:

required:

    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity block. Each identifier is rederived with a
        version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so every value
        differs from the version-1 form and no version-1 value is produced again.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member identifier, assigned when the owner is
            created and formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the version-2 region
            code (the postcode-derived region prefixed with the 'V2' version tag),
            the two-digit fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
            registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), the first eight
            upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest over the 'V2'
            version tag concatenated with the owner's normalized (E.164) telephone
            and the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the
            digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW26A1B2C3D45'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
            deterministically from the 'V2' version tag, the owner's last name and
            postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode are assigned the
            same value, so they form one household.
          type: string
          example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the SHA-256 hex over the
            'V2' version tag, the normalized (E.164) telephone, the lower-cased
            email (or empty) and the last name's Soundex code. A create is rejected
            with 409 Conflict only when the whole identity key equals that of an
            existing owner.
          type: string
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
    OwnerPage:
